title: Walls and gates
summary: Cheap walls slow predators down. Gates let your units through.
text:
A **Wall** is cheap armoured segments laid in a line: tap where it starts, then where it ends (on touch, tap the end again to confirm). The next line chains on from the end until you tap ✓ Done.

Predators can't cross a wall: they have to chew through it, which takes time while your guns work on them. Your units drive round walls, so leave a gap, or drop a **Gate** onto the line: your units pass through it and predators can't.

- Walls don't widen your build area
- Walls hold up a pack, they don't stop it: put guns behind them
- Burrowers tunnel under walls, and flyers and Striders don't care about them
